svg.title: From sources to supported claims
svg.desc: A search page and saved log lead to citation records matched against a trusted source. Unresolved records branch into a separate visible file stack. Verified references lead to reading, shown by highlighted passages and a results table. Source passages are then linked to statements in a draft, retaining findings and disagreements. Record whether an abstract or full text was actually read.
svg.text: and year to a trusted record.
